usage: deskops dispatch [-h] {start,reap} ...

Launch and reap the scion executor and tester of one task.

positional arguments:
  {start,reap}
    start       Launch the executor or tester of a task through scion.
    reap        Stop and delete the finished scion agents of a task.

options:
  -h, --help    show this help message and exit

Examples:
  deskops dispatch start executor --task task-x --root .
  deskops dispatch start tester --task task-x --root .
  deskops dispatch reap --task task-x --root .
